stories.headline: EU crisis chief urges tougher climate action amid France, Spain wildfires
stories.description: Hadja Lahbib calls for existing plans to be accelerated and more investment as an ominous heatwave threatens.

stories.headline: Russia charges Telegram founder Pavel Durov with ‘aiding terrorism’
stories.description: Russia’s FSB says Telegram has not pulled content used by Ukrainian intelligence and ‘terrorist’ groups to plan attacks.

stories.headline: OpenAI says its rogue AI tried to hack other companies
stories.description: The out-of-control AI found four logins which allowed it to access multiple unnamed online services.

stories.headline: How has the Indian government responded to ‘Cockroach’ protests?
stories.description: The BJP government’s response so far has been a measured crackdown as it also attempts to woo the youth.

stories.headline: A safe space for Gaza women: A sanctuary to speak, heal and share amid war
stories.description: A women’s safe spaces initiative in Gaza offers psychological support and awareness sessions.
